intendedUse: presentation kinematics derived from the Deetjen dove surface sequence
excludedClaims: crow force, power, or free-flight prediction

doveScaffold.kinematicUse: The measured-derived dove component deformation supplies only the temporal articulation scaffold. Presentation time is rescaled and the surface is allometrically remapped; it is not relabeled as measured crow motion.

selectedCrowEstimate.tailTipShape: broad and approximately squared with individually resolved rectrices

simulationTransform.surfaceThicknessTreatment: solver raster half-thickness in lattice cells; not a measured feather thickness

antiFabricationRule: Every rendered crow is labeled estimated hybrid. Dove measurements, published crow ranges, and artistically estimated geometry/material parameters remain separately identified.
